title: Provenance tags
statement: A YMM register holds 32 distinct optional input tags, not bytes. Replaying an instruction sequence on tags establishes the complete permutation and every produced zero in one run; equal byte values can hide a wrong permutation, tags cannot. Because tags are symbolic, a permutation-only instruction set needs no bit-vector arithmetic at all: minimality becomes pure SAT, and DRAT falls out natively.

formal.statement: ByteTags = [Option<u8>; 32] with distinct Some tags; instruction = function on ByteTags.
